audit.why: Karma out-ranges Poppy pre-6 with no ranged answer from Poppy; lane difficulty text already reflects this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Steadfast Presence as the defining cooldown but never gives its actual number, and lint flags no digit anywhere in the field.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s by rank per the kit; stating the real number lets the reader count the window instead of guessing.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldowns for Steadfast Presence (20-12s) and Keeper's Verdict (140/120/100s).

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions from missingInteractions were never stated: Keeper's Verdict (R) grants untargetable during its channel (dodges committed burst), and it is a channel that any hard CC (Karma's W root, Mantra-W) cancels outright. Neither appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: This is decisive all-in information — spending your full combo into an active R wastes it, and landing CC on Poppy while she channels cancels her ultimate for free.
audit.corrected: Added as spikes[3] (create-only, was missing a 4th entry) and folded the channel-cancel half into dontsFull[2].d, replacing a copy-paste bleed.
